entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used by UE to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the network. Requires both UE and network to support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates transmission of protocol data using the extended protocol configuration options IE.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that receives protocol data transmitted via the extended protocol configuration options IE.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options supported end-to-end
entities.description: Condition that both UE and network must support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: UE includes the extended protocol configuration options IE in messages when it wishes to transmit protocol data to the network.
Inclusion of extended protocol configuration options IE is conditional on both UE and network supporting it end-to-end for the PDN connection.
